description: Add mild bilateral cataracts diagnosed 2 years ago
presentation: A 78-year-old woman with history of hyperlipidemia, androgenetic alopecia, TIA, and osteopenia (on alendronate for the past year) presents because her dentist plans a tooth extraction with bone graft and implant. She was diagnosed with mild bilateral cataracts 2 years ago. She is at high fracture risk due to her advanced age and weight, but no other FRAX risk factors. She is concerned about medication-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (MRONJ). Her only other medications are aspirin and atorvastatin. When should alendronate be held and resumed with respect to the procedure?
